label: KTB and S4 route frames together entail the S5 route frame
description: If the route's modal frame is reflexive and symmetric (KTB) and also reflexive and transitive (S4), it is reflexive and Euclidean (S5). Not a transcription (invariant 16): the conclusion's Euclidean conjunct appears in neither premise and is derived by the proved modal-library lemma TruthCore.Modal.symmetric_transitive_implies_euclidean (from w R l and w R r, symmetry gives l R w and transitivity gives l R r), which could fail for a frame lacking either condition. Establishes no frame premise.
